* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Jizzy.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Jizzy|Jizzy]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Jizzy.png]]Jizzy's Club, Battery Point, San Fierro
|}
{{control selector|Playstation 2,PC,Xbox}}
After the cutscene, you must head to an abandoned van under the freeway in Downtown. When you arrive, four guys on motorbikes head off, and you have to chase them on a similar bike to retrieve the packages. To get them, drive directly behind the bike, and press {{control|{{psx|L1}}|{{kbd|L-ctrl}}|{{xbox|B}}}} to grab the package, or you can do a drive-by and kill the thief. If you choose not to kill the thieves, they will chase you and shoot at you from their motorbikes. Once you have all four packages, head back to the club to complete the mission.

== Rewards ==
* '''Cash''': $5,000
* '''Respect''': +20
